title: Coin Change Minimum Count - Solution
intuition: Return the fewest number of coins that you need to make up that amount. If amount cannot be made up, return -1.
step_by_step_explanation: Iterate through elements and apply logic accordingly.
common_mistakes: Use bottom-up DP. State dp[i] holds min coins for amount i. Transition: dp[i] = min(dp[i], dp[i-coin] + 1) for each coin.
